mapper.select:
select
, bri.id as rights_id, bri.name rights_name from base_menu_info bmi left join base_menu_rights bmr on bmr.menu_id = bmi.id left join base_rights_info bri on bri.id = bmr.rights_id order by bmi.order_num desc, bmi.id desc

SELECT , bri.id as rights_id, bri.name as rights_name FROM (SELECT DISTINCT brm.menu_id FROM base_role_menu brm JOIN base_role_info bri ON brm.role_id = bri.id JOIN base_role_group_link brgl ON bri.id = brgl.role_id WHERE brgl.group_id = #{groupId}) AS allowed JOIN base_menu_info bmi ON bmi.id = allowed.menu_id left JOIN base_menu_rights_link bmrl ON bmrl.menu_id = allowed.menu_id left JOIN base_rights_info bri ON bri.id = bmrl.rights_id ORDER BY bmi.order_num DESC, bmi.id DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS (SELECT boi.id FROM base_menu_info boi WHERE id = #{id} UNION SELECT boi2.id FROM base_menu_info boi2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = boi2.parent_id) SELECT * FROM child_nodes
